import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

# The camera is outside the right wall, which otherwise blocks its view into the room.
wall = bpy.data.objects.get('Box.043')
if wall:
    wall.hide_render = True

def material(name, color, roughness=0.6, metallic=0.0):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.diffuse_color = (*color, 1.0)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*color, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = roughness
    bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metallic
    return mat

wood = material('Perimeter cabinet stained oak', (0.19, 0.105, 0.055))
panel = material('Perimeter cabinet inset oak', (0.145, 0.078, 0.039))
glass = material('Display cabinet muted glazing', (0.33, 0.43, 0.41), 0.24)
metal = material('Perimeter cabinet dark hardware', (0.045, 0.041, 0.035), 0.32, 0.65)

def group(name):
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, None)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    return ob

def cube(name, loc, size, mat, parent):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=loc)
    ob = bpy.context.object
    ob.name = name
    ob.dimensions = size
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)
    ob.data.materials.append(mat)
    ob.parent = parent
    return ob

def pull(name, x, y, z, parent, width=0.16):
    cube(name, (x, y, z), (width, 0.025, 0.025), metal, parent)
    for dx in (-width * 0.4, width * 0.4):
        cube(name + ' mount', (x + dx, y + 0.017, z), (0.018, 0.04, 0.018), metal, parent)

def framed_panel(parent, label, x, y, z, width, height, inset_mat=panel):
    cube(label + ' inset', (x, y + 0.012, z), (width - 0.10, 0.025, height - 0.10), inset_mat, parent)
    for dx in (-width / 2 + 0.035, width / 2 - 0.035):
        cube(label + ' stile', (x + dx, y - 0.008, z), (0.07, 0.055, height), wood, parent)
    for dz in (-height / 2 + 0.035, height / 2 - 0.035):
        cube(label + ' rail', (x, y - 0.008, z + dz), (width, 0.055, 0.07), wood, parent)

# Tall hutch against the back wall, with a bank of four glazed doors.
left = group('Left tall display cabinet')
cube('Left cabinet lower body', (-2.15, 3.27, 0.54), (2.65, 0.66, 1.08), wood, left)
cube('Left cabinet plinth', (-2.15, 3.21, 0.07), (2.76, 0.77, 0.14), wood, left)
cube('Left cabinet divider ledge', (-2.15, 3.20, 1.10), (2.77, 0.78, 0.10), wood, left)
cube('Left display backing', (-2.15, 3.54, 2.08), (2.62, 0.08, 1.90), panel, left)
for x in (-3.43, -0.87):
    cube('Left display side', (x, 3.27, 2.08), (0.09, 0.57, 1.94), wood, left)
for z in (1.16, 2.99):
    cube('Left display horizontal case', (-2.15, 3.27, z), (2.65, 0.57, 0.08), wood, left)
for i in range(4):
    x = -3.12 + i * 0.645
    framed_panel(left, 'Left glazed door %d' % (i + 1), x, 2.96, 2.08, 0.62, 1.80, glass)
    for z in (1.78, 2.38):
        cube('Left glazed door crossbar', (x, 2.92, z), (0.59, 0.055, 0.045), wood, left)
    cube('Left glazing latch', (x + 0.23, 2.91, 1.66), (0.025, 0.025, 0.10), metal, left)
    cube('Left lower drawer', (x, 2.91, 0.91), (0.60, 0.055, 0.20), wood, left)
    pull('Left drawer pull', x, 2.87, 0.91, left, 0.13)
for i in range(2):
    x = -2.79 + i * 1.28
    framed_panel(left, 'Left lower door %d' % (i + 1), x, 2.91, 0.49, 1.22, 0.63)
    cube('Left lower door knob', (x + 0.43, 2.85, 0.54), (0.045, 0.04, 0.05), metal, left)

# Long base cabinet and the shallower glazed wall cupboard above its open backsplash.
right = group('Right wall and base cabinets')
cube('Right base carcass', (1.77, 3.24, 0.52), (4.24, 0.73, 1.04), wood, right)
cube('Right base plinth', (1.77, 3.17, 0.07), (4.36, 0.84, 0.14), wood, right)
cube('Right dark countertop', (1.77, 3.14, 1.08), (4.38, 0.90, 0.10), panel, right)
for i in range(4):
    x = 0.20 + i * 1.045
    cube('Right drawer front', (x, 2.85, 0.87), (0.98, 0.055, 0.22), wood, right)
    pull('Right drawer pull', x, 2.81, 0.87, right, 0.16)

    cube('Right base door knob', (x + 0.32, 2.79, 0.52), (0.04, 0.04, 0.045), metal, right)

cube('Right upper cabinet backing', (1.77, 3.55, 2.60), (4.24, 0.08, 1.02), panel, right)
for x in (-0.32, 3.86):
    cube('Right upper cabinet side', (x, 3.34, 2.60), (0.09, 0.50, 1.06), wood, right)
for z in (2.10, 3.10):
    cube('Right upper cabinet rail', (1.77, 3.34, z), (4.25, 0.50, 0.09), wood, right)

    framed_panel(right, 'Right glazed door %d' % (i + 1), x, 3.07, 2.60, 1.00, 0.94, glass)
    cube('Right upper door latch', (x + 0.35, 3.02, 2.38), (0.025, 0.025, 0.10), metal, right)
